context_and_flow.screen_type: Mobile app informational/educational screen for financial features.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: Explain the process of collecting money via QR codes and payment links, provide usage inspiration, and encourage adoption.
ux_patterns: The layout uses card-based design for the steps and testimonial.
The typography is sans-serif, clean and highly readable.
The color palette uses Careem's signature brand green for primary actions and highlights.
The illustrations are simple, flat, 2D vector style icons, placed to support the instructional content.
